title: ophioglossum vulgatum subsp. alpinum
intro: Ophioglossum vulgatum subsp. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Adder's Tongue, is a subspecies of rare and endangered plant belonging to the family Ophioglossaceae. It is a perennial plant with long, narrow leaves and a distinctive tongue-shaped frond. The Alpine Adder's Tongue is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-edematous, and antiseptic effects.
